decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is the core of the firm's announced binding mobile communication strategy and embodies substantial sunk R&D, so management persists with it.
Mobile PDF signing supports the publicly announced move into online contract signing, and weak uptake can still be blamed on slow market adoption of e-signatures.
The multi-layer security architecture is the visible backbone of the integrated offer, so dropping it would undermine earlier commitments and positioning.
The email-to-app delivery robot extends the committed secure communication channel, so management still treats modest results as a temporary adoption lag.
Despite the shift to app-based authentication, sunk hardware investment and remaining regulated customers lead management to keep the QR token for now.
The payment security compliance suite underpins the regulatory positioning the firm has announced, and slow results are attributed to long compliance cycles.
